expectedRealization.rationale: The event is a worsening downcycle; a future turning point would require supply cuts plus realized margin/profit stabilization.

changeHypothesis.summary: DRAM/NAND pricing and inventory deteriorated through Q3. Strong H1 profits at 兆易创新/北京君正 were backward-looking relative to the newly worsening industry data, and there was no supply/earnings inflection by cutoff.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce expected further double-digit Q4 declines.
disconfirmingEvidence: H1 company profits were still positive/strong, so the negative thesis had not fully entered reported earnings.
Stocks were already de-rated, creating future bottoming optionality but not a current buy signal.
